title: Sinusoidal positional encoding
goal:
Implement the fixed encoding from Section 3.5:

$$PE_{(pos,\,2i)} = \sin\!\left(pos / 10000^{2i/d_{\text{model}}}\right), \qquad PE_{(pos,\,2i+1)} = \cos\!\left(pos / 10000^{2i/d_{\text{model}}}\right)$$

Write `sinusoidal_pe(n, d)`, which returns an `(n, d)` float array for positions `0` to `n - 1`. `d` is even. Even columns hold sines and odd columns hold cosines, interleaved as the formula shows.
hints: Build `pos` as a column `(n, 1)` and the dimension index `i` as a row `(1, d // 2)`. Broadcasting gives an `(n, d // 2)` array of angles.
The divisor is `10000 ** (2 * i / d)`, where `i` runs over pairs: `0, 1, ..., d // 2 - 1`.
Write sines into `pe[:, 0::2]` and cosines into `pe[:, 1::2]`. Don't concatenate the two halves.
